QuestInfo.name: The True Winter King / Winter Queen Event of 2010!
QuestInfo.0: Winter is here, and the chilly cold is already affecting everyone! If you wish to become the Winter King or Winter Queen of 2010, you'd better go see Cassandra.
QuestInfo.1: What, she's going to give you a present? All you did was train diligently throughout the winter!
QuestInfo.2: On a cold winter day in 2010, you have become the ultimate Winter King or Winter Queen.
